facts.fact: The Niger communications ministry states that on 14 November 2025 the minister received several fibre-optic sections of the Trans-Saharan Optical Fibre Backbone (DTS), the Niger component supported by the African Development Bank, a project meant to link Niger to Algeria, Chad, Nigeria and Benin.

systems.owner: Niger government, Niger component supported by the African Development Bank
systems.tiers: national and regional interconnection with Algeria, Chad, Nigeria and Benin
